title: Integrate camera input + CBV(b0) across compute/volumetric passes
summary: Wire keyboard/mouse input to a Camera class, update per-frame constants, and bind a 256-byte aligned CBV(b0) for all compute passes (density, raymarch, particles).
rationale: DXR_0019 notes CBV and input integration gaps. Ray marching (VOL_0003) requires view/projection and inverse matrices to generate rays and for reprojection in VOL_0004.
steps: Add CBV(b0) to global/compute root signatures used by volumetric passes.
Ensure Camera constant buffer is created (256B aligned) and updated each frame.
Handle WM_KEYDOWN/WM_MOUSEMOVE in WndProc and control Camera (WASD + mouselook).
Bind camera CBV via SetComputeRootConstantBufferView before density/raymarch/particles dispatches.
Log camera params (position, yaw/pitch) each second for validation; add PIX events.
Verify barriers remain correct; no changes to HDR transitions needed.
acceptance_criteria: Moving camera changes on-screen result (density slice/raymarch).
PIX shows CBV bound for compute dispatches.
No D3D12 debug errors; stable at 60 FPS baseline.
risks: Mismatched root signatures between PSOs and command list bindings
Input handling threading issues (ensure on main thread WndProc)
validation: Check logs for periodic camera state output
Capture PIX and inspect root parameters
Wiggle camera and observe parallax in volume
